full_category_description: The Robin Hood Foundation and the organizations AI names as its peers
intro: When donors ask AI about a {product} or about where to give, it can lean heavily on Wikipedia and Wikidata. BrandTabulator measures how fully and recently each organization is described on those sites, and how often it is read by people and machines. BrandTabulator refreshes every week, so bookmark this tab.

Of course, there are many sources that AI relies on. My work is to Diagnose the responses, Investigate the sources they credit, and Prescribe what can be done to improve the visibility and accuracy of a brand's descriptions in AI (DIP).
I'm available for workshops, speaking engagements and consultations for brands in AI. Contact Michael@MichaelQuinn.ai
